articles.title: Hamas military wing told donors to avoid sending crypto directly from Binance, DOJ filing shows
articles.snippet: Hamas’ military wing advised donors not to use Binance to handle funds but rather to use Trust Wallet, Bybit, OKX, Kast and Redotpay to send funds to an external TRON wallet, according to recent U.S. Department of Justice documents.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger
articles.snippet: Bitcoin corporate treasuries remained at an unrealized loss on their holdings as the price fell below $80,000 and fresh capital inflows dwindled.

articles.title: AI Pause Would Help Dominant Firms, Not Safety, Think Tank Warns
articles.snippet: Cato favors voluntary safeguards, while Block Chairman Jack Dorsey backs independent testing and narrowly justified restrictions.
